JordanJordan in July 2017BornMichael Bakari Jordan (1987-02-09) February 9, 1987 (age 39)Santa Ana, California, U.S.Occupation(s)Actor, producerYears active1999–present Michael Bakari Jordan (/bɒkɒriː/; born February 9, 1987) is an American actor and producer. He is known for his movie roles as shooting victim Oscar Grant in the drama Fruitvale Station (2013), boxer Adonis "Donnie" Creed in the Rocky sequel movie Creed (2015), and Erik Killmonger in Black Panther (2018).[1][2][3][4] In 2026, he won the Academy Award for Best Actor for his role as Smoke/Stack in Sinners.
